definitions.explanation: After a long time or much effort, something is accomplished. Expresses relief or satisfaction that something desired has happened.
Only just managing to do something, with difficulty.

examples.japanese: やっと{終|お}わりました!
やっと{日本|にほん}に{来|く}ることができました。
examples.english: I was finally able to come to Japan.

examples.japanese: やっと{間|ま}に{合|あ}いました。
examples.english: I barely made it in time.

notes: Always written in hiragana. Similar to とうとう (finally) but やっと has a more positive connotation of relief or accomplishment after effort. とうとう can be used for negative outcomes too.
